input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds us. Section 2(a) affirmatively confirms that Client is free to acquire, develop, license or use competing software and services (subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and confidentiality), which exceeds the playbook's preferred position. The Client covenants in Section 8 are limited to legal compliance, access control, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions and content warranties — none restrict the businesses we may operate or products we may buy or build. The only "Non-Competition Agreement" reference (Section 8(d)) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data, i.e., a restraint on the vendor, which is acceptable. The licence-scope wording in Section 2(a) ("in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables") limits permitted use of TrueLink's Interface rather than our business activities, so it is not a field-of-use restraint on us. No redline required; separately, diligence on the referenced Non-Competition Agreement is advisable since it is not defined here.
